features.name: Argus Observatory: Local-First Decision Lab & Signals
features.description: Interactive control center and simulation lab comparing five playback strategies (Balanced, Fast Start, Quality, Reliable, Data Saver) with deterministic ranking traces and local capability signals.
knownLimitations: Decision Lab currently runs deterministic simulations against synthetic candidate fixtures.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Exposes Decision Lab traces with human-readable explanations, observes browser capabilities, and allows switching playback trade-off profiles.

features.name: Intelligent Stream Scoring & Ranking
features.description: Multi-signal stream ranking incorporating debrid cache status, resolution, audio formats, seeders, sticky release group continuity, and dead/verified hash adjustments.
knownLimitations: Release group normalization depends on torrent filename regex heuristics.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Top stream correctly prioritizes verified working links (+150), sticky series release groups (+25), and demotes reported dead hashes (-500).

features.name: Argus Flow: Adaptive Automation & Effortless UX Modes
features.description: Signature three-mode UX engine (Effortless, Balanced, Control Room) unifying automated stream selection, background stall recovery, contextual audio/subtitle preferences, and decision explanations.
knownLimitations: Control Room mode exposes raw candidate rankings and latency metrics intended for advanced users.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Effortless mode initiates playback of top-scored verified stream with zero confirmation clicks; Balanced prompts before major switches; Control Room exposes full candidate diagnostics.

features.name: Argus Smart Stream: Quality-Aware Adaptive Selection
features.description: Two-stage candidate selection combining Stage A elimination of unplayable/mismatched links with Stage B multi-signal weighted scoring across Best Quality, Fastest Reliable, and Balanced modes.
knownLimitations: Bitrate throughput safety margin (1.5x) uses EWMA range estimation; live IPTV streams use dedicated buffer limits.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Selects the highest verified playable release matching user target resolution without downgrading to 1080p merely for latency; preserves resume position on fallback.

features.name: Interactive Stream Feedback & Verified Working Links
features.description: User stream upvoting (+150 ranking boost), verified badges, dead link marking (-500 demotion), and structured 5-factor issue reporting popover.
knownLimitations: Ratings stored in local profile storage; sync to remote indexer not yet enabled.
features.acceptanceCriterion: User can click thumbs-up to instantly verify and rank up a working link or open a report drawer with 5 categorized failure reasons.

features.name: Playback Doctor: Intelligent Failure Diagnosis & Self-Healing
features.description: Diagnostic engine that evaluates playback failures, distinguishes provider timeouts, codec incompatibilities, subtitle transcoding issues, and insufficient network throughput, and presents explainable one-click recovery options.
knownLimitations: Underlying hardware decoder capability queries depend on libmpv/avcodec surface on desktop.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Distinguishes between provider timeouts (HTTP 5xx/408), codec decode errors, and network stalls with confirmed vs. probable confidence levels and offers seamless one-click fallback.

features.name: Self-Healing Playback & Frozen-Clock Recovery
features.description: Automatic stall detector that monitors playback progress, identifies frozen frame clocks (>8s without decoded frame progress), and automatically switches to the best standby stream while preserving position.
knownLimitations: Fallback candidates must be pre-resolved or resolvable within 3 seconds; maximum 3 sequential retries before user prompt.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Triggers failover switch within 8 seconds of decoded frame clock freezing without losing resume position.

features.name: Unified Connection Health & Diagnostics Dashboard
features.description: Centralized real-time health inspection panel aggregating Stremio addons, Debrid providers, and self-hosted media servers with latency probes, error rates, and connection status.
entryPoints: Settings > Advanced > Repair & Diagnostics > Connection Health
knownLimitations: Latency measurement is based on HTTP round-trip time; bandwidth throughput is probed separately.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Runs parallel health probes across all active addons, debrid accounts, and media servers, displaying color-coded status and millisecond latency.

features.name: Local Whisper ASR Speech Recognition & Subtitle Generation
features.description: On-device speech-to-text generation using local Whisper GGUF models with Apple Metal acceleration, bandpass pre-filtering, and live cue streaming.
knownLimitations: Requires local model download (tiny ~140MB up to small ~1.5GB); high CPU/RAM usage on non-Apple-Silicon platforms without GPU acceleration.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Transcribes audio PCM frames and renders synced live subtitles within 1.5 seconds of speech utterance.

features.name: SDH Subtitle Preferences, Ranking & Synchronization
features.description: User preference toggle for Subtitles for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing (SDH), prioritizing SDH caption tracks and auto-aligning sync with audio voice activity.
entryPoints: Settings > Player > Subtitle Preferences > Prefer SDH
knownLimitations: Relies on standard SDH/hearing_impaired flags in subtitle stream metadata or track naming conventions.
features.acceptanceCriterion: When Prefer SDH is enabled, subtitles with hearing-impaired flags rank above standard dialog tracks.

features.name: Native AirPlay Streaming & Device Handoff
features.description: Bonjour/AVFoundation AirPlay device discovery and media handoff to Apple TV and AirPlay-compatible receivers.
knownLimitations: AVFoundation AirPlay bridge only functional on macOS; Windows and Linux return unsupported platform error.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Lists local AirPlay receivers on macOS and successfully transfers active stream URL to destination.

features.name: Watch Together / SyncPlay Real-time Collaboration
features.description: Peer-to-peer room playback synchronization over WebSocket/WebRTC relays with synchronized clock, shared play/pause, seek events, and canvas drawing.
knownLimitations: Both participants must have access to the same stream URL or debrid provider account.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Synchronizes play, pause, and seek events across peers with clock drift maintained under 250ms.

features.name: Trickplay Seek Thumbnail Previews
features.description: Hover thumbnail preview scrub bar utilizing BIF archives, sprite sheets, or eager background frame extraction.
knownLimitations: High bandwidth usage if extracting live frames from uncached torrents; throttled on battery power.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Timeline hover displays preview thumbnail for target second within 150ms.

features.name: Privacy-First Redacted Diagnostics Export
features.description: Zero-leak diagnostic report generator scrubbing user tokens, API keys, local home directories, IP addresses, and session credentials.
entryPoints: Settings > Advanced > Repair & Diagnostics > Export Diagnostics
knownLimitations: Export is purely local JSON text file.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Exported diagnostic JSON contains zero sensitive API keys or full username directory paths.

features.name: Profile-Isolated Saved Searches & Bookmarks
features.description: Per-profile search query history with pin/bookmark toggles and empty-state quick navigation chips.
knownLimitations: Synced locally per profile in IndexedDB.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Switching active profiles cleanly isolates saved searches with zero cross-profile bleed.

features.name: Adaptive Bandwidth & Low-Overhead Head Probing
features.description: Lightweight concurrent HTTP range probing on top candidate streams to estimate connection throughput and display confidence badges.
knownLimitations: Restricted to top 5 candidates to prevent rate-limiting and wasteful bandwidth consumption.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Calculates EWMA stream throughput within 400ms and annotates stream card with bandwidth confidence.

features.name: Universal Media Identity & Canonical Disambiguation
features.description: Multi-indexer media entity reconciliation handling alternate titles, release years, season/episode numbering, anime cours, and director cuts.
knownLimitations: Special episodes, OVAs, and complex anime cour split numbering occasionally require manual search fallback.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Accurately confirms matching media identity across Stremio, Cinemeta, and Debrid release titles.

features.name: Local Network Media Server & Peer Discovery
features.description: mDNS / Bonjour network probing for automatic detection of local Plex, Jellyfin, and Argus instances on the subnet.
entryPoints: Settings > Media Servers > Scan Local Network
knownLimitations: Requires local Wi-Fi multicast and firewall pass-through; some routers block mDNS across VLANs.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Discovers active local media servers within 3 seconds of initiating scan on same subnet.

features.name: Local-Model AI CI Repair System
features.description: Automated CI failure diagnosis and bounded patch generation pipeline using local LLMs with reproducible test verification and pull request generation.
entryPoints: GitHub Actions CI workflow failure trigger
knownLimitations: Bounded to 3 repair retries; strictly enforces no arbitrary shell commands and requires passing typecheck.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Detects CI job failure, parses compiler log, applies validated patch, and opens automated fix pull request.

features.name: Unified Add-on Optimizer & Redundancy Engine
features.description: Interactive audit wizard analyzing installed add-on telemetry, response latency, stream overlap redundancy, and capability coverage with one-click optimization recommendations.
knownLimitations: Stream redundancy evaluation uses heuristic scraper overlap scoring.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Audits installed addons, highlights capability gaps (e.g. missing subtitle providers), detects redundant scrapers, and enables one-click non-destructive pausing of failing endpoints.

features.name: Argus Trust Center & Permission Sandboxes
features.description: Centralized privacy and transparency hub exposing local storage inventory, integration network permissions, explainable stream decision logs, and dependency independence scores.
knownLimitations: Endpoint traffic inspection relies on client-side fetch wrappers rather than OS packet filter.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Exposes local storage data inventory, active integration permissions, and allows one-click export of redacted diagnostics with zero leaked credentials.

features.name: Integration Conformance Lab & Protocol Validator
features.description: Automated validator running protocol conformance checks across manifests, catalogs, metadata, streams, and subtitle responses to detect protocol violations early.
knownLimitations: Tests are non-destructive and query public-domain sample film (Night of the Living Dead) to protect user privacy.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Validates add-on responses against Stremio protocol specifications, detecting missing fields, invalid stream URLs, and empty catalogs without failing on non-matching test titles.

features.name: Experience Contract & Policy Authorizer
features.description: Fail-closed local policy engine gating automatic source switching, external AI services, telemetry, and unattended integration installation with explicit user authorization.
knownLimitations: Enforcement currently active at experience engine boundary; full subsystem gating is expanding across background daemons.
features.acceptanceCriterion: Enforces fail-closed authorization: denies external AI, telemetry, and auto-installation unless explicitly enabled by user.
